description: A multiplex agent-based simulation on a network with family, work/school, and community layers. Agents adopt or abandon mask-wearing based on personal risk perception, social exposure by layer, received information, demographic modifiers, and a government intervention beginning on Day 10. Parameters are calibrated on days 0–29, then used to predict days 30–39.

parameters.initial_state_source: train_data.csv day==0 or initial_mask_wearing if day 0 missing

behaviors.name: compute_layer_exposure
behaviors.description: Compute fraction of masked neighbors per layer using previous day states and aggregate to a weighted exposure score.
behaviors.algorithm: For each layer L in {family, work_school, community}, compute f_L = mean(state_{t-1} of neighbors in layer L). Exposure_L = exposure_effect_by_layer[L] * f_L. WeightedExposure = sum_L layer_influence_weights[L] * Exposure_L.

behaviors.name: receive_information
behaviors.description: Generate or replay received_info for each agent-day.
behaviors.algorithm: If day <= 29: received_info_t = observed from train_data.csv. Else: compute p_info = sigmoid(theta0_info + theta_peer_info * WeightedExposure + theta_policy_info * 1[day >= intervention_day] * broadcast_intensity). Sample received_info_t ~ Bernoulli(p_info).

behaviors.name: adopt_mask
behaviors.description: Non-wearers may adopt based on risk perception, social exposure, received info, demographics, and policy.
behaviors.algorithm: For agents with state_{t-1} = 0, compute logit(p_adopt) = beta0_adopt + beta_risk * risk_perception + beta_social * WeightedExposure + beta_info * received_info_t + beta_policy_adopt * 1[day >= intervention_day] + offset(age_group, occupation). Sample adopt_t ~ Bernoulli(p_adopt). If adopt_t=1 then set state_t=1.

behaviors.name: drop_mask
behaviors.description: Wearers may abandon mask wearing, with risk reduced by exposure and information; policy can reduce drops.
behaviors.algorithm: For agents with state_{t-1} = 1, compute p_drop = min(1, p_drop0 * exp(-gamma_exposure * WeightedExposure) * exp(-gamma_info * received_info_t) * exp(-gamma_policy * 1[day >= intervention_day])). Sample drop_t ~ Bernoulli(p_drop). If drop_t=1 then set state_t=0 else state_t=1.

behaviors.name: broadcast_information_policy
behaviors.description: Government increases information probability and nudges adoption after intervention day.
behaviors.algorithm: For day >= intervention_day, set broadcast_intensity=policy_effect_on_info; add policy term beta_policy_adopt=policy_effect_on_adoption in adoption logit; include gamma_policy=policy_effect_on_abandonment in drop calculation.

interactions.name: PeerInfluence
interactions.description: Neighbors’ mask states influence an agent’s adoption and abandonment probabilities via layer-weighted exposure.
interactions.effect: Higher exposure increases adoption probability and decreases drop probability; layer effects differ.

interactions.name: InformationBroadcast
interactions.description: Exogenous and peer-coupled information events that increase adoption odds.
interactions.effect: Increases probability of received_info and thus adoption, decreases abandonment.

steps: Load agent_attributes.csv; validate degrees and convert booleans.
Load social_network.json; deduplicate, symmetrize per layer; validate node IDs.
Join attributes to nodes; set initial state from train_data.csv day 0 when available, else initial_mask_wearing.
Prepare panel features from train_data.csv days 0–29 for calibration: lagged states, received_info, compute per-layer exposures using network and previous day states.
Estimate behavior parameters (Stage 2) using logistic models; map to beta/gamma/theta.
Optionally compute network statistics (Stage 1) for validation: per-layer degree, clustering, assortativity.

algorithms.NetworkConstruction: Use provided social_network.json; symmetrize edges (add reciprocals where missing), remove self-loops, ensure sets per layer. If JSON missing, generate per-layer configuration model respecting degree sequences, homophily, and family clustering via triadic closure.
algorithms.ExposureComputation: For each agent and layer, compute masked neighbor fraction using states at t-1; aggregate with layer weights and layer-specific effects.
algorithms.InfoGenerationModel: Discrete-time logit: p_info = sigmoid(theta0_info + theta_peer_info * WeightedExposure + theta_policy_info * 1[day>=intervention_day] * broadcast_intensity). Replay observed for days 0–29; simulate for 30–39.
algorithms.AdoptionProbability: For non-wearers, logit(p_adopt) = beta0_adopt + beta_risk*risk + beta_social*WeightedExposure + beta_info*info + beta_policy_adopt*1[day>=intervention_day] + group offsets (age_group, occupation).
algorithms.AbandonmentProbability: For wearers, p_drop = p_drop0 * exp(-gamma_exposure*WeightedExposure) * exp(-gamma_info*info) * exp(-gamma_policy*1[day>=intervention_day]).
algorithms.SynchronousUpdateLoop: For day t from 1..T: compute exposures from states at t-1; generate info_t; for each agent sample adoption or drop based on prior state; update states simultaneously; record outputs.
algorithms.CalibrationStage1_NetworkStats: Compute per-layer degree distributions, clustering (especially family), and assortativity by age_group and occupation; compare to targets.
algorithms.CalibrationStage2_BehaviorEstimation: Fit logistic regressions on train days 0–29: (i) adoption among non-wearers, (ii) drop among wearers. Features: risk, exposure by layer (or weighted exposure), received_info, policy indicator, age_group and occupation fixed effects. Map coefficients to model parameters.
algorithms.Evaluation: After simulating days 0–39 with calibrated parameters, compute RMSE over days 30–39 vs actual; compute Peak Adoption Rate Error and Time-to-Peak Error for the intervention window.

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Agent attributes and per-layer degree targets; initial_mask_wearing fallback.

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Multiplex network topology for family, work/school, and community layers.

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Time series for calibration (days 0–29), including daily wearing_mask and received_info; initialize day 0 states.

files.description: Global configuration parameters, paths, and defaults.

files.name: data_loading.py
files.description: Load and validate CSV/JSON; join attributes; preprocess booleans and categories.

files.name: network.py
files.description: Build/symmetrize multiplex network; compute network statistics.

files.name: agents.py
files.description: Agent and Government classes with behaviors; exposure computation helpers.

files.name: dynamics.py
files.description: Core update rules for info generation, adoption, and abandonment; synchronous loop.

files.name: calibration.py
files.description: Fit logistic models, compute group offsets, map coefficients to parameters; save/load calibrated params.

files.name: simulation.py
files.description: Orchestrate initialization, run training-period replay, predictive simulation, and output collection.

files.name: evaluation.py
files.description: Compute RMSE, Peak Adoption Rate Error, and Time-to-Peak Error; plotting utilities if needed.

files.name: metrics.py
files.description: Utility functions to compute daily prevalence, event rates, and exposure distributions.

files.description: Entry point; parse CLI args, run calibration, simulation, and evaluation for days 30–39.
